description: A single sharing-preference toggle: leading icon chip, title + subtitle, a color-independent status word (Shared/Private or On/Off), and a switch. Thin wrapper over the Settings archetype SettingsRow (switch variant) — MUST be visually identical to it. Fully tokenized against design-system.ts.

icon.description: Leading glyph (wallet-outline, swap-horizontal-outline, card-outline, trending-up-outline, flag-outline, pricetag-outline, notifications-outline)

onLabel.description: Status word when on (ACTIVITY row passes 'On')

offLabel.description: Status word when off (ACTIVITY row passes 'Off')

statusWord.colorIndependence: glyph + word + switch position are three redundant cues; never color-only

skeleton.recipe: Skeleton 34x34 radius.md (chip) + flex1 two lines (60% / 40%) + Skeleton 44x26 radius.full (switch pill)

accessibility.label: {title}{, subtitle}{, onLabel|offLabel}
accessibility.state: accessibilityState.checked reflects value; announces on change
accessibility.target: whole row >= 48pt (>= 44pt min); switch target is the full row, not just the thumb
